claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: MG-132 most plausibly kills cells at 2.5 uM by inhibiting the 26S proteasome, causing accumulation of ubiquitinated proteins and proteotoxic/ER stress, and this is expected to produce broad cytotoxicity.
